title: Accept dotted SpecSync module IDs and HI sub-criterion IDs, keep bundled skill prose free of em and en dashes, and remove a mistaken completed entry (DRIVE-1, DRIVE-7, DRIVE-8; issues 56 and 57)
description: Accept dotted SpecSync module IDs and HI sub-criterion IDs, keep bundled skill prose free of em and en dashes, and remove a mistaken completed entry (DRIVE-1, DRIVE-7, DRIVE-8; issues 56 and 57)
no_spec_change_rationale: ID acceptance within REQ-cli traceability and checkpoint requirements as written: the requirements already defer criterion IDs to HI and module and requirement IDs to SpecSync, so accepting exactly the IDs those tools accept changes no requirement or criterion text; removing a mistaken completed entry is a checkpoint update under the existing canonical checkpoint requirement; docs/cli.md states the accepted forms and the new flag
acceptance_criteria: chough init, checkpoint, next, status, context and timing accept and keep SpecSync module IDs with dots such as chat.service, room.service, linked-wallet.service and identity-wipe.service, cases files and case IDs for such a module are read and checked, and requirement links such as REQ-chat.service-1 are kept; checkpoint --criterion and bug add --criterion accept every criterion ID HI accepts, including sub-criterion IDs such as UX-12.a, CHAT-34.a and SEND-1.a.1.b, with no length cap of its own; plain criterion IDs Chough accepted before, such as UX-012 and ux-1, stay accepted so existing checkpoints and bugs stay readable (review 5761422487); module IDs SpecSync refuses, such as a/b, .., CON and trailing., dotted criterion IDs HI refuses, such as UX-1.A and UX-1..a, and requirement or case IDs with no letter or digit are refused with nothing saved; a test fails if any bundled skill file contains U+2013 or U+2014; checkpoint --remove-completed removes one exact completed entry and refuses an entry that is not there with nothing saved; the new tests fail on main 8298e5a where they cover changed behavior; docs/cli.md states the accepted forms and the flag; fledge lanes run verify passes

answers.constraints: Bounded fix for Leif's t811u items 1 and 7 (first two bullets) and issues 56 and 57 only: no new dependency, no schema or output-key change, no change to stage gates, native reads or who approves; Chough still refuses to record human approval or review; module IDs follow SpecSync 6.1.2 validate_module_name and criterion IDs follow hi 0.8.0 Id::parse exactly; no em or en dashes in prose
